title: 第123章 师兄妹组合第122章 小钱
slug: 不是吧这魔修过于正义
content_zh:
燕倾顺着声音看过去。
只见来人一袭飘逸的白底蓝边道袍，生得剑眉星目，丰神俊朗，身姿挺拔如松。
这等长相和气质，放在寻常人堆里，绝对是那种让人一眼看去便心生好感的名门正派少侠。
不过，这位少侠此刻的形象却实在有些幻灭。
他满头大汗，手里紧紧攥着一把佩剑，正像个操碎了心的老妈子一样，对着钱音音喋喋不休地抱怨着。
“小师妹，你跑这么快作甚？师兄我在后面御剑都差点没追上你！如今这世道多不太平你又不是不知道，你这般莽撞，万一遇到歹人可如何是好？”
钱音音无奈地翻了个大大的白眼：“哎呀，周师兄！这里可是高兴镇！是我爹的地盘，能有什么歹人？”
周龙苦着脸，一边拿袖子擦汗，一边苦口婆心地教导：“师妹，你可千万别掉以轻心。你又不是不知道咱们凌天剑宗现在是个什么光景！”
“若不是你仗着师父宠你，天天在他老人家跟前软磨硬泡，非要吵着回乡探亲……师父他老人家也是被你缠得实在没办法，再加上他暗中琢磨了一番，觉得那位灭了老祖的恐怖大能随时可能会杀上凌天剑宗清算，你留在山门里反倒更危险。”
“师父说，让你借着探亲的名义，躲在这偏僻的凡俗小镇里避避风头，或许反而会安全一些。所以才破例允许你下山，还千叮咛万嘱咐，让我这个当师兄的务必要寸步不离地保护你的安全。”
“结果你倒好，一进镇子就跟撒欢的兔子似的，一溜烟就没影了，这要是出了岔子，我回去怎么跟师父交代？”
钱音音吐了吐舌头：“知道啦知道啦，师兄你最好了，等会让我爹请你吃大餐！”
一旁的燕倾面色有些古怪。
这钱音音师兄口中那个灭了老祖的恐怖大能，好像就是他？
他要是知道了，恐怕当场就得吓尿了。
这时候，喋喋不休的周龙终于停下了话头，注意到了站在一旁双手抱胸、戴着面具的燕倾。
他上下打量了燕倾一眼，虽然觉得对方戴着面具略显古怪，但身上并没有半点灵力波动，看起来就像是个寻常的凡人。
周龙收起了刚才那副老妈子的姿态，理了理衣襟，疑惑地问道：“师妹，这位是？”
“这位就是平安饭馆的掌柜呀！”
钱音音立马跳到燕倾身边，扬起小脸，像献宝似的骄傲介绍道：“我的燕哥哥！”

听到师妹这么介绍，一向循规蹈矩的周龙本着出门在外要以礼待人的理念，立刻神色一肃。
他上前一步，双手郑重其事地抱拳作揖，朗声问候道：“燕哥哥好！”
此言一出，空气突然安静了一瞬。
钱音音猛地往后跳开半步，嫌弃地搓了搓胳膊上的鸡皮疙瘩，发出一声夸张的：“咦——”
“我叫燕哥哥，那是因为我跟燕哥哥关系好！你怎么也跟着叫燕哥哥？”
钱音音上下打量着周龙，眼神逐渐变得警惕起来：“师兄，你该不会……有什么龙阳之好吧？我可警告你哦，你不许跟我抢！”
“啊？！”
周龙先是一愣，随即猛地反应过来自己刚才那句称呼在两个大男人之间有多么诡异暧昧。
他那张俊朗的脸庞瞬间涨得通红，简直跟煮熟的虾子一模一样。
“不不不！师妹你莫要胡说八道！我、我只是顺着你的话……”
content_en:
Yan Qing followed the sound and looked over.
I saw that the person who came was wearing an elegant Taoist robe with a white background and blue edges. He had sharp eyebrows and starry eyes, a handsome figure, and a figure as tall and straight as a pine tree.
With this kind of appearance and temperament, among ordinary people, he is definitely the kind of upright young hero from a well-known family that makes people fall in love with him at a glance.
However, the young hero's image at this moment is really a bit disillusioned.
He was sweating profusely and clutching a sword tightly in his hand, complaining endlessly to Qian Yinyin like a heartbroken old woman.
"Little Junior Sister, why are you running so fast? Senior Brother, I was holding my sword from behind and almost didn't catch up with you! It's not like you don't know how unfair the world is nowadays. You are so reckless. What should you do if you encounter a bad person?"
Qian Yinyin rolled her eyes helplessly: "Oh, Senior Brother Zhou! This is Happy Town! It's my father's territory, how can there be any evil people?"
Zhou Long grimaced, wiping the sweat with his sleeve, while teaching earnestly: "Junior sister, you must not take it lightly. It's not like you don't know what the situation of our Lingtian Sword Sect is now!"
"If you hadn't relied on Master to favor you, you would bully him in front of him every day, insisting on going back to his hometown to visit relatives... Master is also pestering you and he has no choice. In addition, he has secretly thought about it and feels that the terrifying power who destroyed the ancestor may kill Lingtian Sword Sect at any time to liquidate him. It would be more dangerous for you to stay in the mountain gate."
"Master said that it might be safer for you to hide in this remote mundane town in the name of visiting relatives to avoid the limelight. That's why I made an exception and allowed you to go down the mountain, and also told me, as a senior brother, to protect your safety at all times."
"It turned out to be good for you. As soon as you entered the town, you were like a rabbit having fun and disappeared in a flash. If something goes wrong, how will I explain to the master when I go back?"
Qian Yinyin stuck out her tongue: "I know, I know, senior brother, you are the best, I will let my father treat you to a big dinner later!"
Yan Qing on the side looked a little strange.
It seems that the terrifying power that Senior Brother Qian Yinyin mentioned that destroyed the ancestor was him?
If he knew, he would probably pee on the spot.
At this time, Zhou Long, who was chattering endlessly, finally stopped talking and noticed Yan Qing standing aside with her arms folded and wearing a mask.
He looked Yan Qing up and down. Although he felt that the mask on the other person was a little strange, there was no spiritual power fluctuation on his body and he looked like an ordinary mortal.
Zhou Long put away his motherly attitude just now, straightened his clothes, and asked doubtfully: "Junior sister, who is this?"
"This is the shopkeeper of Ping An Restaurant!"
Qian Yinyin immediately jumped to Yan Qing's side, raised her little face, and proudly introduced her like a treasure: "My brother Yan!"
After hearing this introduction from his junior sister, Zhou Long, who had always followed the rules and treated others with courtesy when going out, immediately looked solemn.
He took a step forward, bowed solemnly with his hands, and greeted loudly: "Hello, Brother Yan!"
As soon as these words came out, the air suddenly became quiet for a moment.
Qian Yinyin suddenly jumped back half a step, rubbed the goosebumps on her arms in disgust, and said in an exaggerated voice: "Eh-"
"My name is Brother Yan. That's because I have a good relationship with Brother Yan! Why do you also call me Brother Yan?"
Qian Yinyin looked Zhou Long up and down, and his eyes gradually became wary: "Senior brother, you don't know...anything about Longyang, okay? I'm warning you, you are not allowed to rob me!"
"Ah?!"
Zhou Long was stunned for a moment, and then suddenly realized how strange and ambiguous the title he just said between the two grown men was.
His handsome face turned red instantly, looking exactly like a cooked shrimp.
"No, no, no! Junior sister, don't talk nonsense! I, I just follow your words..."
